header: An excerpt that fades into a button
subheader: A visual boundary, not an access check.
bodytext:
The excerpt is normal rich text. Its height is capped, and a gradient fades it out into the band’s background colour. The fade shows where the free part ends.

What the fade does not do

Everything here is in the page source, for every reader and every search engine. The fade hides nothing from anyone who looks, so only put public text in this field.

Access control stays with TYPO3’s page access rules on the page the button links to. This element only draws the line; it does not check who may cross it.
note: The note says who can read the rest, and how readers without access can still get it.
